profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at GE Aerospace | Army Infantry Officer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineering leader and U.S. Army Infantry Officer with a unique blend of technical expertise and proven leadership experience. I hold Bachelor of Science degrees in Computer Science and Mathematics, providing a strong analytical foundation that I have applied across enterprise software engineering, AI-enabled systems, and military operations.

As an engineer, I have designed and delivered enterprise and mission-critical software using Java, Python, C++, TypeScript, React, Angular, Spring Boot, SQL Server, and NoSQL databases. My experience spans software architecture, cloud-native development, CI/CD, DevOps, and AI-enabled software systems, with hands-on expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory, and modern engineering practices. I enjoy solving complex technical challenges while building scalable, reliable systems that deliver measurable impact.

In the Army, I serve as a Ranger-qualified Infantry Officer with leadership experience ranging from rifle platoon command to battalion-level current operations. These roles have strengthened my ability to lead high-performing teams, make decisions under pressure, manage risk, and execute complex operations in dynamic environments.

I hold an active DoD Secret Security Clearance and am a licensed Private Pilot (Single Engine Land). Whether leading engineers, mentoring teams, or building software, I am driven by continuous learning, technical excellence, and delivering meaningful results.

I welcome opportunities to connect with professionals interested in software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, aviation, defense, and technical leadership.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Serve as a technical leader responsible for designing, architecting, and delivering scalable, next-generation software solutions powered by modern AI and agentic technologies. Lead engineering initiatives from concept through implementation while driving technical strategy, system design, and cross-functional collaboration.

Provide senior-level code reviews and technical mentorship, establishing engineering best practices, maintaining high standards for code quality, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Champion software excellence through thoughtful architecture, rigorous review processes, and the adoption of emerging technologies that enhance developer productivity and product capabilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led end-to-end development of mission-critical software features for custom aerospace applications, designing and implementing scalable solutions using Java Spring Boot, Angular, and Microsoft SQL Server. Managed the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis through deployment and ongoing support.

Owned and optimized continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub, improving release efficiency, automation, and software quality. Partnered with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and quality assurance to enhance application performance, reliability, and usability while delivering high-quality solutions in a fast-paced development environment.

positions.title: Digital Technology Leadership Program (DTLP)
positions.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer – Design, development, & deployment of GE Aviation Plant
Applications’ scalable landing site for global utilization on manufacturing floors.

Data Scientist – Research, development, & enhancement off various machine
learning models for part-cost prediction in government contract negotiations. 

Cloud Engineer – Developed and deployed a migration process for on-premises
storage of GE turbine engine parametric flight data, to AWS Cloud Services.

Technical Project Manager – Oversaw design, development, & deployment of GE
Additive’s global contact center software solution.

positions.title: Infantry Officer
positions.description:
Professional Experience & Military Education
* Current: S3 Current Operations (CUOPS), Headquarters and Headquarters Company (HHC), 1st Battalion, 149th Infantry Regiment
* Battalion Scout Platoon Leader, Detachment 1, HHC, 1st Battalion, 149th Infantry Regiment
* Rifle Platoon Leader, Alpha Company, 1st Battalion, 149th Infantry Regiment
* Executive Officer, Bravo Company (Rear Detachment), 1st Battalion, 149th Infantry Regiment

Military Education & Professional Development
* Basic Airborne Course | October 2025
* Basic Military Mountaineer | May 2025
* Ranger School | June–August 2023
* Infantry Basic Officer Leader Course (IBOLC) | January–May 2023
* Distinguished Honor Graduate, Officer Candidate School | October 2020

positions.title: Network Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Comprehensive understanding and hands-on experience programming and
implementing CISCO networking devices on state-wide area network.

positions.title: Air Traffic Systems Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Researched various navigational waypoints to quantify self-imposed traffic
restrictions and increase departure flows through the airlines’ seven domestic hubs.

Developed web-based tools which are being employed daily by air traffic
coordinators in the Network Operations Center of the world’s fourth largest airline
utilizing FAA SWIM feeds to visualize real-time flight and weather data.

Completed projects are the first SWIM applications for a major airline on an
operational scale.
